book.name: SAN LUCAS
book.title: TZOTIꞌ CꞌUL YET COLBANILE TZꞌIBN̈EBILCANO YU NAJ SAN LUCAS

content: Huneꞌ naj chimal isnimanil cawxican̈ yu Comam Jesús

Haꞌ yin̈ huneꞌ tzꞌayical xewilal, to Comam Jesús waꞌo bey yatut huneꞌ naj iswiꞌehal yin̈ ebnaj fariseo. Aypaxicꞌo xin huntekꞌanxa ebnaj yet fariseohal naj tuꞌ, yaben tzet chu yaycꞌay Comam yin̈ huno tzotiꞌ.
Yapni huneꞌ naj sata Comam, chimal yoj yeb isnimanil.
Iskꞌamben Comam tet ebnaj cuywawom yin̈ isley naj Moisés, yeb tet ebnaj fariseo: —¿Chimisje jan̈ten hunu anma yaꞌay yin̈ istzꞌayical xewilal, mato mach chuhi? ẍi Comam.
Yajaꞌ maẍticꞌa takꞌwi ebnaj. Yoc tzabno Comam yin̈ iskꞌab naj yaꞌay tuꞌ, iscawxican̈ naj xin. Lahwi tuꞌ ischejlaxtopaxo naj yu Comam.
Yalni Comam tet ebnaj: —Kꞌinalo ta chitohcꞌay hunu heyuninal maca hunu hewacax yul hunu cꞌuh, ¿tom mach cheyihti yin̈ an̈e, walca istzꞌayical xewilal? ẍi Comam.
Yaj xin maẍticꞌa yu istakꞌwi ebnaj yin̈ tzet yal Comam.
Yal Comam Jesús huneꞌ cuybanil yin̈ anma chiawtelax yin̈ mohyilal
Hayet yilni Comam Jesús anma awtebil tuꞌ issaynilo anma huntekꞌan tzꞌon̈obal ayco yin̈ meẍa caw ay yelapno yehi, yalni Comam huneꞌ cuybanil tiꞌ tet anma:
—Hayet chexawtelax yin̈ hunu mohyilal, mach chexay tzꞌon̈no yul chꞌem caw ay yelapno yehi. Yuto ta chꞌapni hunu naj ecꞌbal yelapno ye tesataj,
cat yapni naj awten̈e hex tuꞌ, cat yalni naj teyet: “Acano huneꞌ tzꞌon̈obal tet naj tiꞌ,” ta ẍi naj, cat heto yin̈ txꞌixwilal bey huneꞌ comon chꞌem.

Wal xin hayet chexawtelaxi, saywe huntekꞌan comon tzꞌon̈obal bay chextzꞌon̈i, haxinwal yet chꞌapni naj quexawten tuꞌ, cat yalni naj teyet: “Hex wamigo ecꞌanweti yul tzꞌon̈obal bay caw ay yelapno ye tilah,” ẍi naj. Haxinwal chꞌoc hewinajil sata ebnaj ayco tecꞌatan̈ sat meẍa tuꞌ.
Yuto haꞌ mac chiyican̈ isba, chiꞌilaxayoj, wal mac chiyiyo isba, chiꞌilaxcan̈, ẍi Comam.

Yalnipaxo Comam tet naj awten tuꞌ: —Hayet chawawten anma waꞌo tacꞌatan̈, mach han̈cꞌan̈eho hawamigo chawawte yeb hawuẍtaj yeb hawicꞌal yeb anma kꞌalom ay hacawilal, yuto haꞌ ebnaj tuꞌ, chakꞌ ebnaj selel tawet yet chaẍyawtenpaxo ebnaj waꞌo iscꞌatan̈.
Wal xin ta ay hunu hakꞌin̈ chawecꞌtze, cat hawawten anma waꞌoj, awte anma mebaꞌ, anma mach tzꞌajano ye isnimanil, anma mach chu yeqꞌui, yebpaxo anma mach chu yilni.
Ta hac tuꞌ chawute, sakꞌal hawet chal tuꞌ, yuto chachah ispaj selel yin̈ huneꞌ tzꞌayical bay chiitzitzbican̈ anma ayxaco yul iskꞌab Comam.
Yechel huneꞌ niman kꞌin̈
Hayet yabelax huneꞌ tuꞌ yu anma ayco sat meẍa tuꞌ, yalni huneꞌ naj tet Comam: —¡Sakꞌal yet anma chiwaꞌ iscꞌatan̈ Comam Dios yet huneꞌ tzꞌayical tuꞌ! ẍi naj.
Yuxin yal Comam Jesús hacaꞌ tiꞌ: —Yet hunel ay huneꞌ naj winaj ecꞌtzen huneꞌ niman kꞌin̈. Caw xin txꞌiꞌal anma yawte naj waꞌo iscꞌatan̈.
Hayet lan̈anxa yapni yorahil yoc wah tuꞌ, ischejnito naj iscꞌamteꞌ yalno tet ebnaj awtebil tuꞌ hacaꞌ tiꞌ: “Ton̈wej yuto cꞌulxa ye tzet chelo,” ẍi naj.

Hayet yaben ebnaj tzet yal naj cꞌamteꞌ tuꞌ, yalni naj babel: “Lan̈anto inlokꞌnihan huneꞌ intxꞌotxꞌan, haꞌ txꞌotxꞌ chintohan wilaꞌan tinan̈, yuxinto akꞌ nimancꞌulal win̈an, mach chu wapnojan,” ẍi naj.
Haꞌ hunxa naj xin halni hacaꞌ tiꞌ: “Lan̈anto inlokꞌnihan lahon̈cꞌon̈ inwacaxan yet munil, yuxin haꞌ noꞌ chinto wilwehan ismunla tinan̈. Caw akꞌ nimancꞌulal win̈an, mach chu intohan,” ẍi naj.
Yalnipaxo hunxa naj: “Caw tolto quinmohyihan, caw mach chu intohan,” ẍi naj.

Hayet ismeltzo naj cꞌamteꞌ tuꞌ, yalni naj sunil tzet yal ebnaj awtebil tuꞌ tet naj yahaw tuꞌ. Caw xin tit ishowal naj, yalni naj tet iscꞌamteꞌ hunelxa: “Wal tinan̈, asiꞌ yulaj nime beh, yeb yulaj niẍte beh, cat hawiniti sunil anma mebaꞌ, anma caw yan̈yon̈e, anma mach chu yilni yeb xin anma txꞌoj ye yoj,” ẍi naj.
Hunepixto xin ismeltzo naj cꞌamteꞌ tuꞌ, yalni naj: “Mamin, manyijehan inbeycꞌojan wawteꞌan anma maxawal wetan, yaj caw aytopaxo hamanil lah,” ẍi naj.
Yalnipaxo naj yahaw tuꞌ: “Asiꞌpaxo yulaj niẍte beh yebpaxo yulaj nimeta beh, cat hachejniti anma bey watuttiꞌan, haxinwal nohnaxa yul watuttiꞌan, cat istzabloco huneꞌ kꞌin̈ tiꞌ.
Yuxinto chiwalan teyet: Sunil ebnaj awtebil babel tuꞌ, machi hunu ebnaj chiwaꞌo sat inmeẍatiꞌan,” ẍi naj yahaw tuꞌ, ẍi Comam.
Anma chiꞌoc tzujno yinta Comam hinanojab ischahni isyaꞌtajil
Caw hantan̈e anma oc tzujno yinta Comam Jesús. Hayet hunel tuꞌ, ismeltzo isba Comam, yalni tet anma:

—Ta ay mac choche chiꞌoc inchejabojan yaj ta ecꞌbal chaco yanma yin̈ ismam yeb ismiꞌ insatajan, maca yin̈ yixal, yuninal, yuẍtaj, yanab maca chisyaꞌiln̈e isba insatajan, ta hac tuꞌ mach chu yoc inchejabojan.
Haꞌ mac hinan yaben isyaꞌtajil walca chꞌakꞌlax camo yin̈ culus, haꞌ chu yoc inchejabojan.
Kꞌinaloj ta ay hunujex cheyoche heyakꞌacan̈ hunu heyatut caw nimajal chu, ¿tom mach babelo chexoc tzꞌon̈noj, cat hetxumni hanta checꞌay yin̈, yu heyilni ta chexkꞌoji, mato machoj?
Yajaꞌ ta ton̈e niman cheyayo xeꞌ matxa chexkꞌoji helahni teꞌ, chꞌoc anma tzebo teyin̈ yet chilni huneꞌ tuꞌ,
cat yalni: “Huneꞌ naj tiꞌ, ton̈e yicheco naj huneꞌ yatut tiꞌ, yaj machi makꞌoji naj islahni,” ẍim anma tuꞌ.

Macato ta ay hunu naj rey lan̈an isto akꞌo howal yin̈ hunxa naj rey, yajaꞌ lahon̈ebn̈e mil issoldado naj. ¿Mataxca mach babelo chꞌoc tzꞌon̈no naj, cat yilni naj ta chu iskꞌoji naj yin̈ hunxa naj rey ay huncꞌal mil issoldado?
Yajaꞌ ta chistxum naj ta mach chikꞌoji naj chabe, yet nahatto ayto hunxa naj rey tuꞌ, cat yanito naj ischejab iskꞌanno tzet chu yoc yin̈ akꞌancꞌulal yeb naj.
Yuxin, haquexpax tuꞌ hex tiꞌ, ta cheyoche oco tzujnu wintajan, caw yilal quinheyanicojan babel sata sunil tzet ayex, ẍi Comam.
Yet chicꞌayto iscꞌachiꞌal atzꞌam
Hac tuꞌ xin, caw cꞌul atzꞌam atzꞌam yocnico ju, yajaꞌ ta chicꞌayto iscꞌachiꞌal atzꞌam, ¿tzet chu yoc iscꞌachiꞌal hunelxa?
Matxa tzet chꞌocnico atzꞌam tuꞌ, nitam cosomnito xol txꞌo txꞌotxꞌ, maca xol kꞌalem yu yoc abonohal. Wal xin toxan̈e chitirlaxtoj. Txumwelo tzet chalilo huneꞌ chiwaltiꞌan, ẍi Comam tet anma tuꞌ.
